remarks: Welcome to 94 Washington Street #3, a beautifully gut-renovated studio in the heart of SoNo. This bright and stylish home features brand-new finishes throughout, including hardwood floors, a newly renovated bathroom, and a full-size in-unit washer and dryer. The kitchen has been completely refreshed with new cabinets, a modern refrigerator, and a sleek stove, creating a clean and functional space to cook and entertain. Large windows fill the apartment with abundant natural light, enhancing the open, airy feel.  Perfectly situated just moments from SoNo's vibrant restaurants, shops, and waterfront, this location also offers effortless access to Metro North for an easy commute and is only a short distance from the beach. A rare find, this studio delivers both comfort and convenience.
